revisionDesc.change: Machine-assisted first draft by Common Ground, from the directory and electoral-roll records.

body.p: Robert F. Parker is listed as the proprietor of the Commercial Hotel on the corner of Bouverie and Queensberry streets in the 1905 directory.
He is on the 1905 electoral roll as Robert Frederick Parker, 89 Bouverie Street, a victualler. The directory lists the hotel between Nos 87 and 93 Bouverie Street.
See also Commercial Hotel and Hotels.

p.hi: This entry is a machine-assisted first draft by Common Ground, written from the directory and electoral-roll records. Only records that are clearly the same person, at the hotel's address and in a hotel trade, are linked to it. Please correct or add to it.
